articles.title: French actress Marina Vlady passes away at 88; Cannes-winning star appeared in more than 80 films
articles.description: Marina Vlady, the illustrious French actress, has passed away at 88, leaving behind a legacy of over 80 films. articles.description: Dolly Parton’s estate has been pulled into a shocking family legal battle involving her nephew Bryan Seaver and his private security company, Squadron Augmented Protection Services. According to an Associated Press report, a Tennessee judge has granted She’s Alive, the entity managing Parton’s estate, a temporary restraining order against Seaver and SAPS. Court filings accuse Seaver of threatening violence and allegedly attempting to interfere with Dolly Parton’s legacy, business empire and estate operations. The order requires Seaver and SAPS to stay away from She’s Alive employees and prohibits contact with them, including within 1,000 feet.
